Tabitha, Acts 9. A woman was full of good works and alms, and when she died, Peter prayed, and she sat up, alive again, to many glad hearts. The church is not a show, it is people who sew, feed, and love in Jesus' name, and when God does a miracle, it is to point to the God who is life. Small acts of kindness, done for Jesus, are never wasted. Keep serving, keep loving, the Lord can turn tears into a story the street remembers.
